title: Kaiketsu Yanchamaru 3: Taiketsu! Zouringen - Title Screen
description:
The infamous Title Screen theme from the Japanese-Exclusive sequel to Kid Niki: Radical Ninja, although you've probably heard it in a more popular bootleg of the game, Super Mario 14.

I made it loop so it's more usable.
